description.value: Seven creekside and lakefront tent sites at a small private lodge on Lillooet Lake, 10.5 km down a gravel FSR off Hwy 99 near Pemberton; panoramic mountain views, rocky beach, outhouses with shared shower, and solid basecamp access to Joffre Lakes, Stein Valley, and hot springs.

raw_osm.name: Lillooet Lake Lodge
raw_osm.note: Signage here states "Cabins, Cottages, Camping", but it looks like it's primarily a privatly run RV site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the lodge is open year-round with five cabins and seven campsites (creekside and lakefront). The information page lists a shared 'shower building' under Grounds, indicating showers available to all guests. The booking page states reservations are phone-only, which counts as reservations accepted. OSM tags the property as a caravan_site, but the website makes no mention of RV hookups—tent camping and cabins are the primary offerings, contradicting the OSM note.
concerns: OSM tags property as 'caravan_site' but website describes only tent camping and cabins with no mention of RV hookups or services.
Access requires 10.5 km of gravel forest service road from Hwy 99, which may be challenging for loaded touring bikes.
No street address available in OSM or on the website.
OSM note speculates the property is primarily an RV site based on signage, but website content does not support this.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The lodge offers legitimate tent camping open to the public year-round in a scenic backcountry location; a touring cyclist in the Pemberton/Lillooet Lake corridor would directly benefit from this listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pack in / pack out policy stated on camping page. Booking by phone only at (604) 905-9246. Cell coverage available on-site per information page.

wow_evidence: seven campsites (creekside and lakefront)... shared 'shower building'
